title: Do You Call That a Hat?

question.en: What kind of shopping does the writer enjoy,
question.zh: 你认为作者喜欢什么样的购物？

sentences.en: What kind of shopping does the writer enjoy,
sentences.zh: 你认为作者喜欢什么样的购物？

sentences.en: 'Do you call that a hat?' I said to my wife.
sentences.zh: “你把那个叫帽子吗？”我对妻子说。

sentences.en: 'You needn't be so rude about it,'
my wife answered as she looked at herself in the mirror.
sentences.zh: 妻子一边照镜子一边回答。

chunks.x: as she looked at herself in the mirror

sentences.en: I sat down on one of those modern chairs with holes in it and waited.
sentences.zh: 我在那些有洞的现代椅子上坐下来等着。

chunks.x: on one of those modern chairs with holes in it
of those modern chairs with holes in it

sentences.en: We had been in the hat shop for half an hour and my wife was still in front of the mirror.
sentences.zh: 我们在帽子店已经待了半个小时，妻子还站在镜子前面。

sentences.en: 'We mustn't buy things we don't need,' I remarked suddenly.
sentences.zh: “我们不该买不需要的东西，”我突然说。

chunks.x: We must n't buy things we do n't need

sentences.en: I regretted saying it almost at once.
sentences.zh: 我几乎立刻就后悔说了这话。

sentences.en: 'You needn't have said that,' my wife answered.
sentences.zh: “你本来不必说这话的，”妻子回答说。

sentences.en: 'I needn't remind you of that terrible tie you bought yesterday.'
sentences.zh: “我不必提醒你昨天买的那条难看的领带。”

chunks.x: of that terrible tie you bought yesterday

sentences.en: 'A man can never have too many ties.'
'And a woman can't have too many hats,' she answered.
sentences.zh: “女人的帽子也是越多越好，”她回答。

chunks.x: And a woman ca n't have too many hats

sentences.en: Ten minutes later we walked out of the shop together.
sentences.zh: 十分钟后我们一起走出了商店。

sentences.en: My wife was wearing a hat that looked like a lighthouse!
sentences.zh: 我妻子戴着一顶像灯塔一样的帽子！
